name: Raffles Seychelles
desc: Located on the magical island of Praslin, are exquisite villas with private pools, touched by the sublime beauty of white powdered sands, opal-hued oceans and lush green hills. The 30-hectare resort features 87 villas, an outstanding Raffles Spa and a plethora of dining options for an exquisite dining experience. The luxury of space makes the villas the perfect haven for romantic getaways or family stays. Only…
